### Base policies (whole domain)
- `stay_evt_travel_issue_refund`: four categories, request as travel_issue stay request, cleaning-fee clause (no access / uninhabitable on check-in date), posting with reason and request id, funding, never capped, tier does not limit → `travel_issue_refund_standard_cadcef38`, `travel_issue_event_and_review_settings_b826518e` (72 h, category %, cleaning categories). Four retired clauses marked; approval and reporting-window current wording carried in the GSF-on-cancellation hub (overwrites of `stay_ext_departure_service_fee_refund`).
- `stay_evt_payment_schedule`: failed collection, 2 retries, 48-hour grace counted from the first failed attempt's posting time in full clock hours, collection before the boundary keeps the stay, lapse = guest cancellation, no lapse once checked in → `payment_collection_schedule_632bd646`, `payment_plan_schedule_fa4d4350`.
- `stay_booking_terms` (long-stay threshold 28, Long-Term 12.00 %, OT schedule, exempt minimums) → `booking_price_terms_c5d204b8`, `service_fee_and_tax_basis_60f1e452`.
- `stay_evt_refund_settlement` (destination, per-component limit, payout stage from the Payout Methods ledger, host-funded recovery) → `refund_settlement_and_payout_stage_0a819d8d`, `refund_destination_and_host_cancellation_level_f0ab10d2`.
